abstract: OBJECTIVES: To evaluate the associations between breast glandular tissues diameters as determined by CT and b-hCG levels, histological types, tumour spread and prognosis in patients with testicular germ cell tumour. METHODS: Ninety-four patients with pre-treatment CT scan and markers (b-hCG, AFP, LDH) were retrospectively collected. A radiologist measured diameters in all CT examinations and correlation between diameters and log (b-hCG) was assessed (Pearson's coefficient). The ability of measured diameters to predict lymphatic and distant haematogenous metastatic spread was evaluated (ROC curves). The associations between measured diameter cut-off values of 20 and 25 mm and International Germ Cell Cancer Collaborative Group (IGCCCG) classification, lymphatic and distant haematogenous metastatic spread and histological subtypes were evaluated (chi squared test). RESULTS: Breast glandular diameters correlated to log(b-hCG) (r = 0.579) and predicted distant haematogenous metastatic spread (AUC = 0.78). Worse prognosis (intermediate or poor IGCCCG) was shown for 20 mm (27.3 vs. 4.2 %, p = 0.005) and 25 mm (33.3 vs. 6.1 %, p = 0.014). A diameter of 25 mm was associated with non-seminoma (91.7 vs. 48.8 %, p = 0.005). CONCLUSION: Breast glandular tissue diameters correlated with log(b-hCG) and predicted distant haematogenous metastases. Twenty and 25 mm were associated with worse prognosis and 25 mm was able to distinguish between seminoma and non-seminoma. KEY POINTS: • CT breast glandular tissue diameter correlates with log(b-HCG) • Gynaecomastia in CT is associated with worse prognosis • Gynaecomastia in CT is associated with non-seminoma histological subtype.
abstract_ja:
目的：精巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者において、CTで計測した乳腺組織の径と、β-ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(b-hCG)値、組織型、腫瘍の広がり、予後との関連を評価すること。
方法：術前にCT検査と腫瘍マーカー(b-hCG、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)、乳酸脱水素酵素(LDH))を測定した94例を後方視的に収集した。放射線科医がすべてのCT検査で径を計測し、径とlog(b-hCG)の相関をピアソンの相関係数で評価した。計測した径によるリンパ行性転移および遠隔血行性転移の予測能をROC曲線で評価した。20 mmおよび25 mmのカットオフ値と、International Germ Cell Cancer Collaborative Group(IGCCCG)分類、リンパ行性転移および遠隔血行性転移、組織亜型との関連をカイ二乗検定で評価した。
結果：乳腺組織の径はlog(b-hCG)と相関し(r = 0.579)、遠隔血行性転移を予測した(AUC = 0.78)。予後不良(中間またはIGCCCG不良)は、20 mm(27.3% vs 4.2%、p = 0.005)および25 mm(33.3% vs 6.1%、p = 0.014)で認められた。25 mmは非セミノーマと関連した(91.7% vs 48.8%、p = 0.005)。
結論：乳腺組織の径はlog(b-hCG)と相関し、遠隔血行性転移を予測した。20 mmおよび25 mmは予後不良と関連し、25 mmはセミノーマと非セミノーマを区別することができた。
要点：
・CTによる乳腺組織径はlog(b-HCG)と相関する
・CTで見られる女性化乳房は予後不良と関連する
・CTで見られる女性化乳房は非セミノーマの組織亜型と関連する
